name: glare-card
title: Glare Card
description: A portrait card with a dark metallic finish that rotates in 3D as the pointer crosses it. Light bands and a glare move over the surface, and the card settles flat when left alone.
use: A profile, ticket or collectible card should feel like a physical object that tilts in the hand.
avoid: Fixed 320px width, mouse-only tilt, and a dark palette that hides the foil on light pages.
a11y: Tilt and glare are pointer-only and ignore reduced-motion; on touch the card simply stays flat. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall rounded card in near-black navy, faintly banded with diagonal blue foil streaks that catch the light. Bold white text sits at the bottom-left above a small light grey paragraph.
behaves: Moving the pointer tilts the card in 3D and slides the foil bands and glare across its face, then it eases back flat when the pointer leaves. The text stays fixed inside the card.
customise: Pass any text or media as children and adjust padding and layout through className. The foil SVG, rainbow bands, 320px width and tilt factors are fixed in the file.
weight: light: One CSS 3D card with a few gradient layers updated on pointer move.
